name: xauusd-trading-bot-frontend
description: Frontend LIFF app for XAUUSD Trading Bot - User Settings Panel

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); http.createServer((req, res) => { res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*'); res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8'); const urlPath = req.url.split('?')[0]; const file = urlPath === '/' ? 'liff-enhanced-settings.html' : urlPath.startsWith('/') ? urlPath.slice(1) : urlPath; if (!file) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('Not Found'); } const filePath = path.join(__dirname, file); try { if (fs.existsSync(filePath) && fs.statSync(filePath).isFile()) { res.end(fs.readFileSync(filePath)); } else { throw new Error('Not a file'); } } catch (e) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } }).listen(process.env.PORT || 3001); console.log('Frontend running on port', process.env.PORT || 3001); "
